description: Intent i008 (error-path-commit, snapshot s02) complete. FINDING (medium confidence): net/tipc/bearer.c:1311-1350 __tipc_nl_media_set — a generic-netlink control-write doit handler that assigns the return of nla_parse_nested_deprecated() (line 1321-1323) into err but never gates on it; the next statement is 'if (!attrs[TIPC_NLA_MEDIA_NAME])' with no 'if (err) return err;', unlike five sibling handlers in the same file (__tipc_nl_bearer_set at 1110+, plus sites at 925/975/1022/1074, which all check err). Execution then continues to unconditionally commit m->tolerance (1343), m->priority (1345), m->max_win (1347), and m->mtu (1361, UDP media with only a lower-bound check) into the persistent global struct tipc_media that is later re-read per link (b->tolerance = m->tolerance at :340, prio = m->priority at :282). Because lib/nlattr.c __nla_validate_parse memsets tb[] then walks attributes and can return -EINVAL mid-walk (validate_nla policy violation, unknown maxtype, trailing bytes), a write whose attributes the kernel just declared invalid still mutates persistent protocol state with no rollback. Counterevidence: the memset means an error before any tb[] entry is stored leaves attrs[] NULL and the handler bails at !attrs[NAME], so the realistic window is a policy error on a later attribute after NAME/PROP were already stored — hence medium, not high, confidence; policy entries were not enumerated line-by-line. BOUNDED NEGATIVE / TRIAGE: extracted 2327 parse-containing functions across net/, kernel/, fs/, mm/, security/, block/, io_uring/, ipc/ and partial drivers/, filtered with a ±6-line unchecked-return heuristic to 24 suspects and triaged 10 concrete candidates: 7 classified safe with exact evidence (net/can/bcm.c bcm_tx_setup checks err<0 before commits; net/packet/af_packet.c packet_setsockopt folds copy_from_sockptr into ret and gates packet_set_ring under !ret; fs/orangefs/orangefs-sysfs.c sysfs_int_store propagates rc; net/core/rtnetlink.c rtnl_fdb_del checks err<0 immediately; block/error-injection.c, drivers/net/netdevsim/bus.c, drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/cxgb4_debugfs.c all validate), 3 unresolved (ath11k debugfs twt writes, i40e debugfs command write, kexec short-copy segments — all root/debugfs surfaces deprioritized within budget). Limitations: heuristic window ±6 lines may miss delayed checks, macro-wrapped returns, or wrapper-helper validation; drivers/ only partially walked, arch/, sound/, virt/ not scanned; no coccinelle/Smatch available; verification was by source reading of lib/nlattr.c semantics, not a compiled reproducer. Final artifact at agent-state/findings/i008.json contains the literal quote and full candidate/limitation lists.
